enabled.description: Enable or disable the scheduler service. When disabled, the scheduler will not accept jobs.

log_level.description: Logging level for scheduler logs. Common values: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.

log_file.description: Path to the scheduler log file.

host.description: Hostname of the host running the scheduler service. Must be resolvable by other services.

workers.description: Number of worker processes for the scheduler. Increase for higher throughput or concurrency.

host_state_cache_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for cached host state. Reduces database load but may delay visibility of host changes.

default.name: DiskFilter
default.description: Filter based on available disk space

default.name: CoreFilter
default.description: Filter based on available CPU cores

default.name: ImagePropertiesFilter
default.description: Filter based on image properties (e.g., architecture)

scheduler_default_filters.description: List of scheduler filter classes to apply by default. Each element defines the filter name, description, and whether it’s enabled.

description.description: Short human-readable description of the filter's purpose

default.name: AvailabilityZoneFilter
default.description: Boost or penalize hosts based on zone proximity

default.name: RamFilter
default.description: Prefer hosts with more free RAM

default.name: DiskFilter
default.description: Prefer hosts with more free disk

default.name: CoreFilter
default.description: Prefer hosts with fewer used vCPUs

scheduler_weight_multiplier.description: List of scheduler weights and their multiplier values (used to bias selection after filtering).

multiplier.description: Multiplier for this weigher (can be negative to penalize)

scheduler_manager.description: Scheduler manager class (controls how scheduler logic is invoked).

scheduler_max_retries.description: Maximum number of attempts the scheduler will make to find a suitable host before failing.

scheduler_retry_delay.description: Delay (in seconds) between scheduler retries. Helps avoid transient failures.

ram_allocation_ratio.description: RAM overcommit ratio (physical RAM × ratio = available RAM for instances). Values >1 enable overcommit.

cpu_allocation_ratio.description: CPU overcommit ratio (physical cores × ratio = available vCPUs for instances). Values >1 enable overcommit.

disk_allocation_ratio.description: Disk overcommit ratio. Usually 1.0 (no overcommit) for predictable disk use.

reserved_host_memory_mb.description: Amount of RAM (in MB) reserved for the host OS and system processes.

reserved_host_disk_mb.description: Amount of disk space (in MB) reserved for the host OS and system processes.

image_traits_filter_enabled.description: Enable filtering based on image traits (e.g., hardware requirements like GPU or firmware).

aggregate_instance_limit_enabled.description: Enable limiting per-availability-zone or per-host instance counts via aggregates.

numa_topology_filter_enabled.description: Enable NUMA-aware scheduling (matches guest NUMA topology to host NUMA layout).

trust_filter_enabled.description: Enable trust-aware scheduling (e.g., for trusted computing or secure boot support).

image_type_filter_enabled.description: Enable filtering by image type (e.g., baremetal vs virtual machine).

pci_passthrough_filter_enabled.description: Enable filtering based on PCI passthrough device availability.

traits_filter_enabled.description: Enable custom resource class / trait-based scheduling.

availability_zone_filter_enabled.description: Enable filtering by availability zones specified in the request.

io_weight_filter_enabled.description: Enable I/O-based scheduling (e.g., for high-throughput or low-latency workloads).

server_group_affinity_filter_enabled.description: Respect server group affinity rules (schedule together when possible).

server_group_anti_affinity_filter_enable.description: Respect server group anti-affinity rules (schedule on different hosts when required).

zone_filter_enabled.description: Enable cross-zone scheduling (allow scheduling to hosts outside the requested zone).

host_manager.description: Class responsible for managing host state and capabilities.

scheduler_driver.description: Scheduler driver class (e.g., FilterScheduler, RetryScheduler, ChanceScheduler).

use_cached_state.description: Use cached host state for scheduling decisions instead of querying the database each time.

scheduler_stats_driver.description: Driver class for collecting and reporting scheduler statistics.

update_host_state_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between host state updates. Increase for large deployments to reduce load.

scheduler_metrics_enabled.description: Enable scheduler metrics collection (used for monitoring and analysis).

scheduler_metrics_cache_path.description: Path to store scheduler metrics cache (used when metrics are enabled).
